A free 20-30 minute experience. (30 if you're going for 100% achievements)
The graphics are pretty weak. The sound design is quickly thrown together and the game has glitches that could've been fixed if the dev took some time out of their day.

So.. why am I recommending it?
It's short, free and it has an interesting story. 
The mystery that you're trying to solve is pretty fun and dark. Although there are some things in the game that look like they were supposed to have more of a role in the game, it's still fun.

So, overall:
4/10
Below average, but it's still worth your time.

This game has a clever little tale to tell, and the way the narrative unfolds is satisfying enough. As a free game, I can certainly recommend this experience.

However, I'm not sure that this narrative necessarily benefits from being a game. For this particular story, I feel that a written story or short film would be equally effective. The "gameplay" elements are pretty limited here.
Interesting story, played two times to see both endings.

A free 30 minute game about life after death. You find yourself working for Charon collecting tickets off customers onboard as the ferry crosses the river styx. As you meet the handful of passengers on board you begin to realise two things. First that there may be a connection to everyone on board and second you don't exactly know who you are. Eventually all questions are answered through a well developed script and your given a choice at the end to 'return' or 'move on'. Strangely it is at this point that you begin to realise that life might be too painful and death may be the better option.

开场，主角出现在港口（四面都是水，不接陆地），他忘了自己叫什么，也不知道为什么会出现在这里，有一个自称是船长的人催促着他赶紧上船。
船长让主角去收集乘客们的票，在此过程中主角发现船上的每个人都已经死了，而他却不确定自己的死活。和三位乘客的对话中有一个名字，马库斯，而哭泣的女子提到了电梯有时会通向楼下，带着各种谜团乘坐电梯向下，在那里看到了那个戴着面具的神秘人，谜底一一揭晓，原来主角就是马库斯，而三位乘客，依次是他的妹妹，父亲和妻子，神秘人是主角的消极人格的具象化。母亲病逝，妹妹因为自己的一时疏忽死去，父亲整日饮酒，妻子也在等待中离开人世。
最后，在灯塔前，是选择两扇门，一扇，是找到了归宿，另一扇，是继续流浪，一切未知。
